title: Aligned landing hero path labels
summary: Aligned the landing hero annotation dots and labels with the vertical animation path. The path now uses a structured column, each label connector dot lands on that same column, and the label baselines align to the corresponding Plan, Snapshot, and Commit path stops.
userVisibleChange: The landing hero annotations now read as part of the same structured flow: dots, connector lines, and text align with the animated path instead of floating separately.

timeline.title: Aligned hero annotations
timeline.summary: Moved annotation positioning to a fixed left coordinate, aligned connector dots with the path column, and adjusted label y positions to match the path stops.

timeline.title: Verified build and layout
timeline.summary: Ran production build, whitespace checks, a computed layout probe, and captured a desktop screenshot.

decisions.title: Anchor labels with left positioning
decisions.rationale: Right-positioned annotations made connector dots drift relative to the path as card sizing changed. Left-positioning the annotations from the same stage coordinate system keeps dot, line, and label alignment predictable.

decisions.title: Match label baselines to path stops
decisions.rationale: The user-visible issue was that dots and text felt disconnected. Aligning the dot y-position and first-line label baseline to the path stop makes the diagram read as one system.

validation.output: Next.js production build completed successfully; 19 static pages generated.
Path x=286px. Annotation connector dots landed at x=283-287px; label baselines aligned to path stops at y≈190, 364, and 538.
